spans.s:
r. 1st cl. (मादयते) (इ, इर्) मदि r. 1st cl. (मन्दति), and (ई, इर्) मदी r. 4th cl. (माद्यति)
1 To be glad, to be satisfied or content, to rejoice.
2 To be proud.
(इ) मदि r. 1st cl. (मन्दति)
1 To praise.
2 To sleep, to doze, to be lazy or sluggish.
3 To be stupid, to be an idiot or fool.
4 To be elegant.
5 To go or approach.
मद r. 10th cl. (मादयते)
To cause or justify satisfaction or contentment.
मदी r. 1st cl. causal form (मादयति)
1 To delight, to make glad, to exhilarate.
2 To madden or intoxicate, literally or figuratively.
2 To be poor or distressed.
4 To be proud.
With नि prefixed,
(निमादयति)
To articulate.

m. (-दः)
1 Joy, pleasure, delight.
2 The juice that flows from an elephant's temples when in rut.
3 Spirituous or vinous liquor.
4 Inebriety, intoxication.
5 Pride, arrogance.
6 Insanity, madness.
7 Semen virile.
8

Musk.
9

A male river.
10 Passion, desire.
f. (-दी)
1 A drinking vessel.
2 An instrument for making furrows.
E.
मद to be pleased, &c., aff. अप् or अच्.

m. (-दः)
1 Intoxication, literal or figurative.
2

Pride.
3

Joy, extasy.
E.
मद to be delighted or inebriated, and aff. घञ्.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
Speaking inarticulately or like a drunken person.
m. (-लः)
An elephant in rut.
E.
मद inebriety, &c., कल to sound, aff. अच्.

m. (-लः)
A bull that has been liberated at some festival, and is allowed to wander about at will.
E.
मद pleasure, कुह to sound, aff. अलच्.

f. (-न्धा)
Spirituous liquor.
E.
मद intoxication, and गन्ध smell.

m. (-नः)
A buffalo.
E.
मद pleasure, and गमन going.

f. (-घ्नी)
A potherb, (Basella lucida, &c.)
E.
मद inebriety, घ्नी what destroys.

m. (-नः)
1 KĀMADEVA, the Hindu

CUPID.
2

The season of spring.
3 A plant commonly Mayana, (Vangueria spinosa.)
4 Thorn apple, (Datura metel.)
5 A bee.
6 A sort of bean, (Phaseolus radiatus.)
7 Bee's wax.
8 A tree, (Mimosa catechu.)
f. (-ना-नी)
Spirituous or vinous liquor.
E.
मद to exhilarate or rejoice, aff. ल्युट्, fem. aff. टाप्, or ङीष्.

Cloves.
2

Delighting, inebriating.
E.
मद to be pleased, in the causal form, to please, &c., aff. ल्युट्.

m. (-वः)
A pigeon, a dove.
E.
मदन love, काकु change of voice, and रव who utters.

m. (-कः)
The Koïl or Indian cuckoo.
E.
मदन spring, and पाठक reader; announcing the season.

mfn. (-शः-शा-शं)
Subdued by love, in love.
E.
मदन, and वश subdued.

n. (-तं)
1 Sign or effect of love.
2 A species of the Aṣṭī metre.

f. (-का)
1 A provocative medicine.
2 The Mayana, or more properly the Śārikā, a small bird.
3 The female of the Koïl or Indian cuckoo.
E.
मदन love, &c., and शलाका the bird, or a dart, &c.

f. (-का)
The Śārikā or Śārika, a small bird, (Turdus salica.)
E.
मदब love, and सारिका the Śālikā.

m. (-शः)
1 Membrum virile.
2 A finger nail.
E.
मदन KĀMADEVA, and अङ्कुश a goad.

m. (-धः)
Pudendum muliebre.
E.
मदन, and आयुध a weapon.

m. (-यः)
1 A sovereign, a prince.
2 A lotus.
3 Pudendum muliebre.
E.
मदन pleasure, आलय receptacle, abode.

f. (-स्था)
Separation of lovers.
E.
मदन love, अव depreciative prefix, स्था to stay, aff. क, and टाप्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be enamoured.
2 Causing or exciting passion.
E.
मद to delight, अनीयर् aff.

m. (-वः)
The vernal festival of the Hindus, the Holī.
f. (-वा)
A courtezan of heaven.
E.
मदन spring or love, and उत्सव festival.

m. (-गः)
The issue of the fluid from the forehead of an elephant in rut.
E.
मद the fluid, and प्रयोग junction.

f. (-नी)
A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.)
E.
मद inebriety, भञ्ज breaking, इनि aff.

f. (-का)
Arabian jasmine.
E.
कन् added to the next.

f. (-न्ती)
Arabian jasmine.
E.
मद to delight, झच् Uṇādi aff., and ङीप् fem. aff.

m. (-त्नुः)
1 Love or

CUPID.
2

A distiller.
3 A drunken man, a mad man.
4 A cloud.
n. (-त्नु)
Vinous or spirituous liquor.
E.
मद in the causal form, to intoxicate, &c., Uṇādi aff. इत्नुच्.

m. (-गः)
1 Love or

KĀMA.
2

A cock.
E.
मद passion or desire, and राग propensity, inclination.

m. (-प्तः)
A furious elephant, or one in rut.
E.
मद the juice, and विक्षिप्त tossed, agitated.

m. (-न्दः)
An elephant.
E.
मद the juice, and वृन्द a quantity.

n. (-लं)
A tavern, a dram shop.
E.
मद intoxication, and स्थल place.

n. (-नं)
A place where liquor is sold, a tavern, a dram shop.
E.
मद drunkenness, and स्थान place.

mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
Intoxicated, drunk.
m. (-द्यः)
The palm tree.
f. (-द्या)
A sort of Barleria, with red flowers.
E.
मद intoxication, आद्य fit or proper for.

m. (-ङ्कः)
Pain and sickness, consequent upon ebriety.
E.
मद, and आतङ्क fear.

m. (-यः)
Disorder induced by drunkenness; head-ache, sickness, loss of appetite, &c.
E.
मद drunkenness, and अत्यय consequence.

mfn. (-न्धः-न्धा-न्धं)
Blind with pride or passion, arrogant, dissolute, &c.
E.
मद, and अन्ध blind.

m. (-तः)
A drum carried on an elephant.
E.
मद pride, आम्नात minded, respected, from मना with आङ् prefix, and क्त aff.

m. (-रः)
INDRA'S elephant.
E.
मद the frontal fluid, and अम्बर garment, housing.

m. (-रः)
1 An elephant.
2 A rogue.
3 A libertine, a lecher.
4 An elephant in rut.
5 A hog.
6 The name of a king.
7 A sort of perfume, probably musk.
E.
मद to be intoxicated, &c., Uṇādi aff. आरन्.

m. (-दः)
A sort of fish: see फलक.

mfn. (-सः-सा-सं)
Indolent, slothful, overcome with passion or pride.
E.
मद, and अलस idle.

m. (-पी)
The Koïl; or Indian cuckoo.
E.
मद delight, आङ् before लप to speak, aff. णिनि; the song of this bird is constantly heard in the spring in most parts of Hindustan.

m. (-ह्वः)
Musk.
E.
मद musk, and आह्व name.

m. (-रः)
A red species of Khayar, (Mimosa catechu.)
f. (-रा)
1 Wine, spirits, spirituous or vinous liquor.
2 A wagtail.
3 A species of the Ākṛti metre.
E.
मद to be delighted, &c., Uṇādi aff. किरन्, fem. aff. टाप्.

f. (-क्षी)
A woman, a mistress, a wife.
E.
मदिरा wine, अक्षि the eye, षच् and ङीष् affs., whose eyes inebriate like wine.

n. (-हं)
A tavern, a dram shop.
E.
मदिरा wine, and गृह a house.

m. (-खः)
The mango, (Mangifera Indica.)
E.
मदिरा wine or spirits, and सखि the friend.

f. (-णा)
A fascinating woman.
E.
मदिरा, and ईक्षण the eye.

f. (-ष्ठा)
Vinous liquor.
E.
मद what delights or intoxicates, इष्ठन् superlative aff.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
Mine, my own.
E.
मत् for मम mine, and छ aff.

mfn. (-टः-टा-टं)
1 Arrogant, haughty.
2 Furious, mad.
m. (-टः)
1 An elephant in rut.
2 A pigeon.
E.
मद, and उत्कट who is furious.

mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं)
Haughty, arrogant.
f. (-ग्रा)
A woman in general.
E.
मद, and उदग्र elevated.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Drunk, intoxicated.
2 Arrogant, drunk with pride.
E.
मद drunkenness, उद्धत struck, overcome.

mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं)
Drunk or mad with pride, passion, &c.
E.
मद, and उन्मत्त mad.

m. (-द्गुः)
1 An aquatic bird, the shag.
2 An outcaste, the son of a Brahman by a woman of the bard, or panegyrist class, whose employment is hunting wild beasts.
3 A ship, a galley.
E.
मस्ज to emerge, to dive, उ aff., deriv. irr., or मद to be delighted, (in the water,) and गुक् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-रः)
A fish, (Macropteronatus Magur, HAM.)
E.
मद to intoxicate, उरच् Uṇādi aff., and गुक् augment, form irr.; also with कन् added, मद्गुरक्.

f. (-सी)
A sort of fish: see मद्गुर.

n. (-द्यं)
Wine, vinous or spirituous liquor.
E.
मद to be intoxicated (by it), aff. यत्.

m. (-ङ्कः)
Vinous liquor for distilling.
E.
मद्य wine, पङ्क mud.

n. (-नं)
Eating a relish, or what excites thirst.
E.
मद्य wine, पस to go, aff. ल्युट्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Drunk, a drunkard.
E.
मद्य, and पीत drunk.

f. (-ष्पी)
A plant, the blossoms of which are used in distilling: see मद्यवासिनी, &c.
E.
मद्य wine, पुष्प the flower.

m. (-ण्डः)
Yeast, barm, froth.
E.
मद्य wine, मण्ड froth, scum.

f. (-नी)
A shrub, the blossoms of which are used in distilling, (Grislea tomentosa, or Lythrum fruticosum.)
E.
मद्य wine, वस to dwell, aff. णिनि and ङीष्.

n. (-जं)
A drug used to produce fermentation.
E.
मद्य wine, and वीज seed.

n. (-नं)
Distillation.
E.
मद्य vinous liquor, and सन्धान distilling.

m. (-द्रः)
1 Joy, delight.
2 A country enumerated amongst those to the N. W. of Hindustan proper.
3 A sovereign of that country.
f. (-द्रा)
The name of a river.
E.
मदि to be delighted, Uṇādi aff. रक्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Produced, &c. in the country of Madra.
E.
मद्र a country so named, and कन् aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Delighting, giving delight.
E.
मद्र delight, कृ to make, aff. अण्; also with खच् aff., मद्रङ्कर.

f. (-ता)
The wife of Pāṇḍu, mother of the two youngest Paṇḍu princes.
E.
मद्र a proper name, and सुता the daughter.

m. (-द्वा)
A name of ŚIVA.
E.
मद to be intoxicated, वनिप् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Connected with or related to me.
E.
मत् mine, वर्ग a class or number, ख aff.; also with छ aff., मद्वर्ग्गीय; and with यत्, मद्वर्ग्य.

m. (-कः)
A gallinule.
E.
मद to delight, aff. ण्वुल्.

mfn. (-दृक्)
Like me, resembling me.
E.
मा for अस्मट् I, दृश् to see, aff. क्विन्; also with कञ् or क्स, aff. मादृश and मादृक्ष.

f. (-द्री)
The wife of PĀṆḌU, and mother of the youngest of the Pāṇḍava princes.
E.
मद्र a king, अण् patronymic aff.

m. (-तिः)
A name of PĀṆḌU.
E.
माद्री the wife of the sovereign, and पति husband.

m. (-तिः)
A name of PĀṆḌU.
E.
माद्री, and पृथा his other wife, पति husband.
